info.title: Overload API
info.description: Generated from the route schemas in apps/api by `pnpm contract`. Do not edit by hand. Better Auth’s own /api/auth/* routes are not described here.

session.name: better-auth.session_token
session.description: Better Auth’s session cookie, set on the web origin. `__Secure-` prefixed over HTTPS.

bearer.description: The session token from the `set-auth-token` header, for the native client.

Profile.description: Null until the user has set one up.

WeightUnit.description: How weights are shown. Every weight is stored and sent in kg (docs/06, 2026-09-23).

code.description: Stable and machine-readable. Clients switch on this.

routines.description: Present only for `exercise_in_routine`: the routines using it.

missing.description: Present only for `setup_incomplete`: the steps to finish first.

timezone.description: Local dates are read in it: the day boundary.

ProfilePatch.description: Omitted fields are unchanged and `null` clears one. The first save creates the profile.

nextCursor.description: Opaque. Send it back as `cursor` for the next page.
Opaque. Send it back as `cursor` for the next page.
Opaque. Send it back as `cursor` for the next page.
Opaque. Send it back as `cursor` for the next page.
Opaque. Send it back as `cursor` for the next page.

ExportPage.description: One page of one section. `profile` has one item; `exercises`, `routines`, `workouts` and `weighIns` are cursor-paged. Workouts include ones in progress.

secondaryMuscleGroups.description: The groups it also trains, where a working set counts half in the balance view. Each once, in the order of `MuscleGroup`, never `muscleGroup` itself. Empty for none.

aliases.description: Other names for search to match, never shown as the name. Seeded only.

custom.description: True for the caller’s own exercise, false for a seeded one.

overrides.description: Which values are the caller’s own settings rather than defaults.

Equipment.description: A load-increment class, not an equipment inventory (docs/04 `exercise`).

MuscleGroup.description: The one group the library files an exercise under (docs/04 `exercise`).

position.description: Place in the routine list, 0 first.

RoutineSlot.description: Null reps fall back to the caller’s setting, then the exercise’s default.

endedAt.description: Null while the workout is in progress.

clientUpdatedAt.description: The phone’s clock at the last edit.

targetSets.description: Copied from the routine at start.

position.description: Order within the exercise, warm-ups included. Never renumbered.

exercises.description: In order. One that logged no set is still listed.

WorkoutDetail.description: One workout whole. Every row is as the sync batch holds it, so a set can be sent back edited, or deleted, through `/api/workouts/sync`.

measuredAt.description: When the reading was taken, not when it arrived.

source.description: `manual` was typed by hand and can be deleted; `apple_health` cannot be.

ExportSection.description: The sections built so far. Later milestones add theirs (docs/07 §2).

id.description: Made on the device (UUIDv7). A repeat returns the row.

secondaryMuscleGroups.description: The groups it also trains, where a set counts half. Stored each once, in order, without the group it is filed under.
The groups it also trains, where a set counts half. Stored each once, in order, without the group it is filed under.

hidden.description: Off the caller’s pickers; history still names it.

ExerciseSetting.description: The whole setting. `null` restores the exercise’s default for that value.

from.description: The span’s first local date. For `all`, the first workout’s, and null without one.

to.description: Today, in the caller’s time zone.

points.description: One per workout with a working set of it, oldest first.

changeKg.description: The last workout’s e1RM less the first’s, from the estimates before they are rounded, to the thousandth. Null with fewer than two.

stats.description: Over the span: the best e1RM, the heaviest top set with the most reps done at it, and the volume load of every workout together. Null without a workout.

Progress.description: One exercise’s chart (S7). Warm-ups are left out of every number (S6).

Span.description: How far back the chart reads: 4 or 12 weeks, 6 months, 1 year, or everything.

e1rmKg.description: Epley on the best working set, to the tenth.

topSetReps.description: The most reps done at that weight.

volumeKg.description: Volume load: weight × reps, summed over the working sets.

sets.description: The working sets in order: the exercise’s past sets. A bodyweight lift’s are as counted.

basis.description: `same_day`: the day’s own weight. `earlier_day`: no reading that day, so the latest earlier day’s. `later_day`: the workout is older than the first weigh-in, so the first later one.

weighedOn.description: The local date of the weigh-in counted.

basis.description: No weigh-in at all: sets as logged.

bodyweight.description: Which weigh-in a bodyweight lift was counted at (issue #69): all of that weight plus the kg logged on the set.

id.description: Made on the device (UUIDv7). A repeat returns the routine.

position.description: Move to this place in the list, 0 first; past the end means last.

nextCursor.description: Opaque. Send it back as `cursor` for the next page.

total.description: How many finished workouts the caller has in all.

WorkoutList.description: Finished workouts, newest `startedAt` first. One in progress is not listed.

routineId.description: The routine it was started from; null when it came from none, or the routine is gone.

topSetReps.description: The most reps done at that weight.

exercises.description: Each exercise that logged a working set, in the workout’s order.

LastDone.description: When each of the caller’s routines was last done. A routine never done, or deleted, is absent.

LastTimes.description: Every exercise the caller has logged. One never logged is absent.

countedWeightKg.description: The load counted for display; weightKg remains the logged added load.

rir.description: Null when the set recorded none.

sets.description: Working sets only, numbered 1…n in order.

basis.description: `same_day`: the day’s own weight. `earlier_day`: no reading that day, so the latest earlier day’s. `later_day`: the workout is older than the first weigh-in, so the first later one.

weighedOn.description: The local date of the weigh-in counted.

basis.description: No weigh-in at all: sets as logged.

bodyweight.description: Which weigh-in a bodyweight lift was counted at (issue #69): all of that weight plus the kg logged on the set.

slots.description: Last time for each of the caller’s routine slots that has logged the exercise.

reason.example: hit 10 on every set last time

rir.description: Null when the set recorded none.

sets.description: Working sets only, numbered 1…n in order.

basis.description: `same_day`: the day’s own weight. `earlier_day`: no reading that day, so the latest earlier day’s. `later_day`: the workout is older than the first weigh-in, so the first later one.

LastTimeSlot.description: One routine slot’s own sets and suggestion, from the last workout that ran it.

to.description: Today, in the caller’s time zone.

lifts.description: How many lifts have a verdict.

overall.description: The plain average of every verdict’s unrounded percentage, judged before rounding to the tenth for display. Null without a lift to average.

lifts.description: The lifts with a verdict, the largest gain first; then those without, by name.

StrengthOverview.description: Every lift the caller logged with a working set in the span, with the trend of its e1RM. Warm-ups are left out (S6).

StrengthStatus.description: Gaining is a trend up 2% or more across the span, losing one down 2% or more, holding anything between.

e1rmKg.description: Epley on the best working set, to the tenth.

points.description: One per workout with a positive e1RM in the span, oldest first.

workoutCount.description: Workouts with a working set in the span.

status.description: The lift’s verdict, `too_few` below three workouts, `no_trend` when a percentage cannot be calculated, or `no_weight` without a positive e1RM.

changeKg.description: The trend line’s end less its start, to the thousandth.

changePct.description: That change as a share of the line’s start, to the tenth.

basis.description: `same_day`: the day’s own weight. `earlier_day`: no reading that day, so the latest earlier day’s. `later_day`: the workout is older than the first weigh-in, so the first later one.

weighedOn.description: The local date of the weigh-in counted.

basis.description: No weigh-in at all: sets as logged.

bodyweight.description: Which weigh-in a bodyweight lift was counted at (issue #69): all of that weight plus the kg logged on the set.

to.description: Today, in the caller’s time zone.

weeks.description: What the sets are divided by: 4, or 1 for this week.

range.description: The weekly range every group is read against.

groups.description: All eleven groups, in the order of `MuscleGroup`, trained or not.

Balance.description: Working sets a week for each muscle group: whole for the group an exercise is filed under, half for each it also trains. Warm-ups are left out (S6).

sets.description: Working sets a week, whole and half, to the tenth. The status reads this figure.

directSets.description: The whole sets among them, to the tenth: those of exercises filed under it.

status.description: `none` at 0, `low` under the range, `in_range` from its low to its high end, `high` over it.

indirect.description: True where the exercise trains the group indirectly, at half a set.

sets.description: What it adds a week, to the tenth: already halved where indirect.

sources.description: The exercises its sets came from, by when each first came up.

row.description: The server’s copy after this request.

errors.description: Present when the row did not match its schema: the fields at fault, never a value.

endedAt.description: Null while the workout is in progress.

clientUpdatedAt.description: The phone’s clock at the last edit.

routineExerciseId.description: The routine slot it was started from. Null, or left out by a row made before the field existed, when it came from none.

targetSets.description: Copied from the routine at start.

position.description: Order within the exercise, warm-ups included. Never renumbered.

SyncBatch.description: The device’s queued rows, each the whole current row or its deletion, parents before children. At most 500 rows a request.

SyncDeletion.description: A row the phone deleted. It goes if the stored copy is older than `deletedAt`, and its id is kept so a stale copy cannot bring it back.

SyncUnreadableRow.description: Any other row with an id. It is not applied: its result is `refused` with `validation_failed`, and the rest of the batch is applied as usual.

weighIns.description: Every reading in the range, newest first.

days.description: The weighed days in the range, newest first.

trendAvailable.description: False with fewer than 3 weighed days up to `to`.

weekChangeKg.description: The latest trend less the trend a week before today, to the hundredth. Null without a trend, or with no weighed day a week or more before today.

date.description: A local date in the profile’s time zone.

weighInId.description: The reading that stands for the day.

morning.description: False when the day had no reading before 10:00 local and its first reading stands in.

trendKg.description: The trend on this day, to the hundredth. Null while fewer than 3 days are weighed.

id.description: Made on the device (UUIDv7). A repeat returns the row.

revokedAt.description: Null while the invite admits them.

id.description: Made on the device (UUIDv7). A repeat returns the invite.
